<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex066032025-12-1917-23-04" status="reviewed"><milestone unit="section" n="Closing verses (85a5–85a6)"/>
               <lg><l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3831">rig pa 'i dbang phyug chos kyi seng ge</rs>'i ||</l>
               <l>snyan cing mdzes pa'i gsung <lb n="85a6"/> dpyad pa la brten nas ||</l>
               <l>rgyal sras spyod pa dbu ma'i lam 'jug pa ||</l>
                <l>byang chub sems mchog yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrom ||</l>
                <l>byings pa'i rgyud pa ma lus sel byed pa ||</l>
               <l>rnam par phye nas blo ldan skye bo la ||</l>
                <l>ldug par <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3864">bdag</rs> gis phyogs su rgyas byed shog ||||</l></lg></seg></TEI>
